rappel_detail.notes: First of two rappels from the topout alcove/ledges down into Beckey Gully; this is the same rap line used by the standard Liberty Crack and Beckey Route descents.
Second rappel lands near a tree anchor in Beckey Gully; from there, downclimb/walk the gully to the Liberty Bell-Concord notch.

set.rappel_count_note: Two single-rope rappels of about 25 m (80-100 ft by different accounts) from bolted anchors, the same rappel line as Liberty Crack and the lower half of the standard Liberty Bell descent. A 60 m rope is enough.
set.descent_text: Liberty Crack (Free) tops out at the same alcove/bolted anchor used by the original aid line. From there, work along ledges to a double-bolt rap anchor and make two rappels (about 25 m each, 80-100 ft by different accounts) down into the Beckey Gully — the same rap line used by the standard Liberty Crack and Beckey Route descents — landing near a tree anchor in the gully. From there it's a downclimb/walk down the gully to the Liberty Bell-Concord notch and back to the climbers' path. All anchors on this line are bolted (shiny modern bolts plus a tree station); a single 60m rope is adequate for a one-day car-to-car push, though some parties opt to downclimb the sheltered Beckey Route slab unroped instead of rapping the last section.
